purpose: File Transfer Protocol for moving files between systems.
description: FTP is an unencrypted file transfer protocol. Credentials and data are sent in plaintext unless FTPS is used.
real_world_incidents: Data exfiltration via anonymous FTP access on misconfigured servers.
recommended_actions: Disable FTP and use SFTP instead.

audience_guidance.student: FTP sends passwords in clear text. Think of it like shouting a password across a crowded room.
audience_guidance.developer: Migrate from FTP to SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol). Ensure your FTP daemon (e.g., vsftpd) has anonymous_enable=NO.
audience_guidance.bug_bounty_hunter: Check for anonymous login using 'anonymous' / 'anonymous@example.com'. Look for sensitive files or write access.
audience_guidance.pentester: Attempt anonymous login. Sniff traffic if on the same network. Look for exploit modules for the specific FTP daemon version.
audience_guidance.security_team: Monitor for FTP cleartext authentications. Enforce SFTP globally. Restrict FTP ports at the firewall.
